title: fix(plugin-auth): an auth door's unclassified internal failure is answered with the generic message and logged
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:plugin-auth 三个辅助结果映射器(admin 用户门共用的 `mapAuthApiError`、服务账号注册的成员映射、`set-initial-password` 映射)以及 `sys-oauth-application/register` 路由的内层 catch,对未分类的内部故障改答通用文案,并用插件已有的 logger 按路由名记一次 error 日志。
- 为什么改:与 `auth-plugin.ts` 各路由 catch 已执行的同一条规则对齐:未分类的内部故障只答通用文案并在服务端记日志;厂商带 body code 的拒绝、4xx 的拒绝保持原样。
- 风险与回滚:仅 500 类答复的 message 文本变化,code(`INTERNAL_ERROR`)与 status 不变;无文档或客户端解析该文本。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`(`mapAuthApiError` 的分类分支)、`auth-plugin.ts`(`sys-oauth-application/register` 内层 catch)、`service-account-doors.ts`(`vendorRefusal`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/set-initial-password.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中「an unclassified internal failure is answered with the generic message and logged once」一组为绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地

## What changes

The rule, already applied by every route catch in `auth-plugin.ts`: a route's unclassified internal failure is answered with a generic message, and the error is logged server-side. A refusal the vendor classifies (it carries a body code) keeps its own message and status, and so does a throw whose status addresses the caller (4xx). This PR applies it to the three result mappers the auth doors answer through, and to one route catch that did not yet follow it:

- `mapAuthApiError` (`admin-user-endpoints.ts`), shared by create-user, set-user-password, import-users, add-sso-user / import-sso-users (organization join) and `/organization/add-member`: an unclassified failure answers `INTERNAL_ERROR` with `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE` from `@objectstack/types`, the constant those routes' own catches use, and is logged once as `[AuthPlugin] ROUTE failed`.
- `vendorRefusal` (`service-account-doors.ts`), the membership step of `/service-account/register`: after the existing declared-refusal check, an unclassified failure answers `INTERNAL_ERROR` with `The request could not be completed.`, the words that route's own catch (and this file's `WITHHELD_SERVER_MESSAGE`) uses, and is logged once as `[AuthPlugin] service-account/register failed`.
- `mapSetPasswordError` (`set-initial-password.ts`): an unclassified failure answers `INTERNAL_ERROR` with `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE`, logged once as `[AuthPlugin] set-initial-password failed`.
- The inner catch of `POST /sys-oauth-application/register` (`auth-plugin.ts`, the client-creation call): a throw with no vendor body and no 4xx status answers `OAUTH_REGISTER_FAILED` with `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE` (the constant the route's outer catch uses) at the status `resolveThrownHttpError` reads, logged once with `ctx.logger` as `[AuthPlugin] sys-oauth-application/register failed`. A vendor refusal (it carries a body) keeps its `error_description`, its `details.upstreamError` and its status.

Logging seam: each helper is handed the logger the plugin already holds (`ctx.logger`), through an optional `logger` on its deps or options (`error` added as optional to the existing `logger` on `AdminUserEndpointDeps`, `IdentityImportDeps`, `PendingSsoUserDeps`; a new optional `logger` on `OrganizationAddMemberDeps`, `ServiceAccountDoorDeps`, `SetInitialPasswordOptions`; an optional third argument on `mapAuthApiError`). Otherwise `auth-plugin.ts` gains only those hand-offs at three call sites (`set-initial-password`, the service-account deps factory, `/organization/add-member`); no other route catch, no before-hook and no vendor-classified refusal changes. No new dependency, no module-level console, no new error code, nothing in `packages/spec`.

**Why this is not breaking.** For each changed answer the status and the code (`INTERNAL_ERROR`, or `OAUTH_REGISTER_FAILED` at the OAuth registration) are unchanged; only the message of an unclassified internal failure changes. Measured: no page under `content/docs/**` names these routes' 500 message text, the error catalog (`packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`, the error-code ledger) pins the code only, and `git grep` over `ui/`, `packages/client` and `packages/client-react` finds no consumer that reads these fallback texts. Every refusal (a vendor body code, a declared hook refusal, a 4xx status) answers byte-identically. The new deps fields and the third argument are optional, so an existing host compiles and answers the generic message without a log line. Hence a `patch` changeset with `Clause-②: no`.

## Tests

Named by the rule, each helper beside its CONTROLs:

- `set-initial-password.test.ts` — the existing unclassified-throw row now asserts the rule: the generic answer, and the logger called once with the route and the error; a thrown non-Error reaches the logger as an `Error`; CONTROL a vendor body-coded refusal keeps its message, code and status and is not logged; CONTROL a 4xx throw keeps its answer.
- `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts` — the shared mapper directly, then through create-user and set-user-password; CONTROLs for a vendor body-coded refusal (409 normalisation included) and a 4xx throw.
- `organization-add-member.test.ts`, `admin-import-users.test.ts` — the two other mapper callers hand the logger on; CONTROL a vendor body-coded refusal at add-member.
- `oauth-register-refusal-status.test.ts` — on the real route over real better-auth: a client-creation call that throws with no declared status answers 500 in the generic words and the route's log line receives the error once; CONTROL a vendor refusal keeps the vendor's own description, `upstreamError` and status, with no log line. The file's existing pins (declared 4xx statuses, the storage fault at 500, the accepted registration) stay green.
- `service-account-doors.test.ts` — the membership step: generic answer, logged once, nothing written; CONTROL a vendor body-coded refusal keeps its prefixed message and status; CONTROL a 4xx throw keeps its answer. The suite's deps now carry the logger.

<details><summary>Measured before the fix (rule rows red), and the suite after</summary>

- Before (the rule tests against the source of the base commit, tests otherwise as in this PR): `Test Files 5 failed (5) · Tests 8 failed | 194 passed (202)`; the 8 failures are exactly the unclassified rows across the three mappers; every CONTROL passed. The OAuth registration row, before its fix: `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, the CONTROL passing.
- After, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `dbe556761a`: `Test Files 277 passed (277) · Tests 5531 passed | 10 skipped (5541)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (after building the package for its examples program): exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The cloud twin of `set-initial-password` calls `runSetInitialPassword` without a logger: it now answers the generic message, and logs only once it passes its own logger in `SetInitialPasswordOptions.logger`.
- A body-less throw with a 4xx status keeps its message at these mappers (the repo's thrown-error rule: a 4xx message is addressed to the caller). Such a throw is still answered with the code `INTERNAL_ERROR` rather than a code its status derives; that pre-existing labelling is unchanged here.
- `PR #33991` touches a docblock of `admin-import-users.ts` far from these hunks; no overlap.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation: each site's generic arm put back to the thrown-message arm, then restored</summary>

- `set-initial-password.ts`: `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`, then restored.
- `admin-user-endpoints.ts` (`mapAuthApiError`, with the add-member and import-users suites): `Tests 5 failed | 156 passed (161)`, then restored.
- `service-account-doors.ts`: `Tests 1 failed | 29 passed (30)`, then restored.
- `auth-plugin.ts` (the OAuth registration inner catch): `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, then restored.

The tests import each subject from `src/` by relative path, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>
